layer2_night.$comment: Every figure is copied from the dry-run files named in dry_files, never typed. Cell format: status:value_kind|value|reason|winner_unit_id|evidence_kind|evidence_ref; "-" = the cell does not exist on that side; option slots are written <target>@roof_form=<option|threshold>.

street_side_absence_cells.$comment: The principal side_setback_street_m cells that move from not_evaluated:no_candidate to unregulated by absence, by zone and class, copied from transitions.tsv. Five classes move, not four: the absence entries are typed by building type, and the principal building type of house_with_secondary_suite is detached house, so it moves with detached_house. Garden and laneway suite structures do not move (0 cells).

storage.check: No band and no lower limit. The night stops on storage only if the three tables (bylaw_resolution_lots, bylaw_resolution_texts, bylaw_resolution_units) are above 780 MiB. The night record states the measured size beside the predicted 740.10 MiB.
